The explicit dependency from module.aws_eks_managed_node_groups to :resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth duplicates the existing implicit dependency through local.node_group_context, which includes module.aws_eks.cluster_id-derived values but not aws_auth—wait, no direct implicit path to aws_auth is not present, so this explicit dependency is not redundant.
The explicit dependency duplicates the implicit reference to kubernetes_namespace.spark.id in the provisioner command; null_resource.update_trust_policy already waits for the namespace.
The explicit dependency duplicates the implicit reference to aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id in the provisioner command.
The explicit dependency on the managed node group's IAM role duplicates the implicit reference to aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn in node_role_arn.
The explicit dependency on the self-managed node group's IAM role duplicates the implicit role reference in the launch-template input path.
